replies.author: @cheetah2247
replies.text: I met my wife on Instagram in 2018. In December 2020 I went there to ask for her hand in marriage. She is of the Bimba tribe. I flew from Minneapolis Minnesota to Chicago then all the way to Ethiopia and from there to Lusaka, Zambia. I met her and one of her sisters and brother in law. We drove 12 hours back to their home in Chingola. Up there is known as the copper belt. I ate mangos that grew on 3 of the trees in their yard. They also have gava, bananas. We ate enshema with antelope one of the nights. They eat ground nuts which we know as peanuts. I went back in 2022 and we got married, drove through the east side of the country going to Malawi. On the way, we went by bus, we drove past lots of grass and mud huts with ppl walking to work. Lots of ppl standing on the sides of the roads selling goods, bananas, roasted corn on the cob over a fire, watermelon, squash and  fish. Monkeys running on the road and watching traffic. There is also a large chimpanzee national park there as well. I love it there and can't wait to go back. We haven't been to Victoria Falls yet but next trip. She got here in 2024 and we have a 1 year old daughter. It is very peaceful there. My first time to Africa and out of America. A guy on the plane I was on, asked me how was it possible for me to visit there as the first. His favorite place in Africa.
